review.rule: Hand review of reports/2026-10-23-phase5-evaluation.json (2026-10-23). Rule: a store counts for a product when at least one row the engine read there is that product itself: any colour or finish, new, open box or renewed. Rejected: accessories and parts, another model or generation, another capacity or size, a bundle, kit or multi-pack when no row is the product, a multi-capacity listing whose price is another capacity's, and a look-alike. A rejection given as {reason, setups} applies only to those setups (the catalog's rows were wrong, the web's or a recipe's read was the product).
